RATTLE_DRUM.name: Rattle Drum
RATTLE_DRUM.effect: On Summon: +3 Count per scoring BONE dice.
RATTLE_DRUM.lore: A drum made of skins and femurs. But ain't that just normal for drums?

EMBER_JAR.name: Ember Jar
EMBER_JAR.effect: On Summon: +20 Power per scoring FIRE dice.
EMBER_JAR.lore: Do not open indoors. Do not open outdoors either.

FROST_LANTERN.name: Frost Lantern
FROST_LANTERN.effect: On Summon: +5 Power per scoring ICE dice.

MOSS_CHARM.name: Moss Charm
MOSS_CHARM.effect: On Summon: +2 Count per scoring LEAF dice.
MOSS_CHARM.lore: Grows a little greener every time you take a look.

LIGHTNING_ROD.name: Lightning Rod
LIGHTNING_ROD.effect: On Summon: +10 Power and +1 Count per scoring VOLT dice.

IRON_NAIL.name: Iron Nail
IRON_NAIL.effect: On Summon, with at least 2 METAL dices scoring: +30 Power.

GRAVEDIGGER_LAMP.name: Digger Lamp
GRAVEDIGGER_LAMP.lore: Lights the way for those who dig their own graves.

TRIO_TOTEM.name: Three-faced Totem
TRIO_TOTEM.effect: On Summon of a Trio: +8 Count.
TRIO_TOTEM.lore: Three faces, one opinion - more sacrifices!

MOON_CHARM.name: Moon Charm
MOON_CHARM.effect: On Summon of a Full Moon: +10 Count.
MOON_CHARM.lore: Glows softly when the moon is full.

BONE_SAW.name: Bone Saw
BONE_SAW.effect: On Summon, if every scoring dice face is 4 or more: +40 Power.
BONE_SAW.lore: Only cuts the very best of bones.

WISP_JAR.name: Wisp Jar
WISP_JAR.effect: On Summon of a Rabble: x3 Count.
WISP_JAR.lore: A jar of leftover souls. They are fine with the die-ing condition.

GRAVE_ROBBER.name: Graverobber Boons
GRAVE_ROBBER.lore: A sack, a shovel and a flexible attitude toward what counts as your.

DEEP_FREEZE.name: Deep Freezer
DEEP_FREEZE.effect: On Summon, with 3 or more ICE dices scoring: x1.5 Count.
DEEP_FREEZE.lore: A skull frozen in an ice cube. Chilling thoughts.

LOADED_BONE.name: Loaded Bone
LOADED_BONE.effect: On Roll: if no BONE faces, one random dice flips to its BONE face.
LOADED_BONE.lore: A bone dice, weighted with lead for a little cheating here and there.

THRIFTY_GHOST.name: Thrifty Ghost
THRIFTY_GHOST.effect: On Summon: +3 Count for each Reroll you still have.
THRIFTY_GHOST.lore: Saved every coin. Has nothing to spend it on now.

HYBRID_VIGOR.name: Hybrid Vigor
HYBRID_VIGOR.effect: On Summon of a Duo or Full Moon: +6 Count.
HYBRID_VIGOR.lore: A LOTS of potions in one bottle. Shake well before drinking.

COPYCAT_COFFIN.name: Copycat Coffin
COPYCAT_COFFIN.effect: On Summon of a monster type already in your army: +8 Count.
COPYCAT_COFFIN.lore: Two identical coffins. Don't know what inside, but there are probably 2 of them.

OVERGROWTH.name: Overgrowth
OVERGROWTH.effect: On Summon: +1 Count for every LEAF group you ever summoned (now +{counter}).
OVERGROWTH.lore: A vine that remembers every leaf it has ever met.

SPIRIT_BOARD.name: Spirit Board
SPIRIT_BOARD.effect: On Summon of a Rainbow: x2 Count.
SPIRIT_BOARD.lore: It wants to say something but the letters are too faded to be readable.

PIGGY_COFFIN.name: Piggy Coffin
PIGGY_COFFIN.effect: On Summon: +2 Power for each $1 you hold.

GILDED_TOOTH.name: Gilded Tooth
GILDED_TOOTH.effect: On Summon: earn $1 per scoring BONE dice.

BONE_PILE.name: Bone Hairpin
BONE_PILE.effect: On Summon: +2 Count for each unplayed dice with BONE face.
BONE_PILE.lore: Carved from a finger bone could be yours but you don't remember.

COLD_HEARTH.name: Cold Hearth
COLD_HEARTH.effect: On Summon: +15 Power for each scoring dice with 1 or 2 points.
COLD_HEARTH.lore: A fireplace that makes you cold. Very modern design.

GRAND_PROCESSION.name: Grand Progress
GRAND_PROCESSION.effect: On Summon: +15 Power for each group of monsters already in your army.
GRAND_PROCESSION.lore: A tiny banner that makes you feel important.

TACTICIAN_SKULL.name: Tactician's Skull
TACTICIAN_SKULL.effect: On your first Summon of a battle: x2 Power.
TACTICIAN_SKULL.lore: He looks like he's judging your gameplay.

CROWN_OF_THE_LICH.name: Crown of the Lich
CROWN_OF_THE_LICH.effect: On Summon of a Ritual, Quartet or Quintet: x2 Count.
CROWN_OF_THE_LICH.lore: Heavy is the head that wears the heavy crown.

LAST_RITES.name: Last Rites
LAST_RITES.effect: On your last Summon of a battle: x3 Count.
LAST_RITES.lore: The last remains of a glorious battle.

ELEMENTAL_CONVERGENCE.name: Elemental Bracelet
ELEMENTAL_CONVERGENCE.effect: On Summon, once all 6 elements have scored this battle: x3 Count.
ELEMENTAL_CONVERGENCE.lore: Six coloured stones that glow together.

BLOOD_MOON.name: Blood Moon
BLOOD_MOON.effect: On Attack, with 3 or more groups: x1.5 damage.
BLOOD_MOON.lore: Everything hits a little harder when painted red.

BLACK_GRIMOIRE.name: Side-eyed Grimoire
BLACK_GRIMOIRE.effect: On Attack: x1 damage, +0.25 for each boss defeated (now x{value}).
BLACK_GRIMOIRE.lore: Lists every enemies you have ever beaten, in alphabetical order.
